title: SetObject: properties server-set on create but client-updatable
description:
JMAP-x2gd.87 replaced the hand-maintained /set property lists with SetObject::{SERVER_SET, CLIENT_SETTABLE, IMMUTABLE}. One RFC 8620 category does not fit: properties the spec says 'The server sets' on create that a client may still change by update. Two short spec-quoted lists remain for it:
- crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs SET_BY_SERVER_ON_CREATE (position, orientation, leftAt; draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 §SceneAvatar/set)
- crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/participant.rs SET_BY_SERVER_ON_CREATE (role, leftAt, callResponse, lobbyState, kickedBy, unmuteRequested, breakoutCallId)
plus a single-property inline check for 'state' (VTCCall create, VTCRecording/VTCLivestream check_create) and SceneRegion activeCallId (update-only).

Options: (a) leave as is (two small fail-closed lists, spec-quoted); (b) add a fourth const SERVER_SET_ON_CREATE to SetObject with a classification test. Recommendation: (a), constraint over mechanism; revisit only if a third type needs it.
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-23: option (a). Keep the two spec-quoted SET_BY_SERVER_ON_CREATE lists in scene avatar.rs and vtc participant.rs; no fourth SetObject const. Revisit only if a third type needs it.
close_reason: Won't fix per Mark 2026-10-23 (option a): two small fail-closed spec-quoted lists beat new trait machinery
